subject: Commit true‑up: invoice routing, PO & tax evidence for 2028 capacity increase
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Mira Jensen <mira@staleworks.com>, accounts-payable@staleworks.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@staleworks.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commit true‑up: invoice routing, PO & tax evidence for 2028 capacity increase

Hi Mira / AP team,

Thanks again for locking the 2028 capacity commitment during last week's call — excited to get this shipped. Finance asked me to confirm a few items so we can finalize the true‑up invoice and set up the billing flow: 

- Formal PO number to bind the expansion (we can accept a PDF PO via email).
- Preferred billing contact & remit email (AP vs centralized payables).
- Net terms: your team mentioned Net30 on the call; confirm if that remains or if Net45 is required.
- Tax forms: we need your W9 (EIN) for US invoicing.

I'll loop in our billing ops (Ben) once you confirm so we can issue the prorated true‑up invoice for the remainder of 2027 and the 2028 commitment invoice.

If it's easier, attach the PO and W9 to your reply and I'll route to finance.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0193

(Attachment: Redwood_Commit_TrueUp_Proposal_2027.xlsx (xlsx) — proposal summary referenced)

From: Mira Jensen <mira@staleworks.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>, accounts-payable@staleworks.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@staleworks.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit true‑up: invoice routing, PO & tax evidence for 2028 capacity increase

Hi Sergio,

Thanks — confirm we're proceeding. A few notes from procurement/AP: 

- PO: we'll issue PO #SW-PO-9843 and attach it to the email when it's signed internally (aiming to send by 29 Nov).
- Billing contact: payments@staleworks.com (please route invoices to this address).
- Net terms: procurement prefers Net30; however, payments group prefers Net45 for larger, multi‑year commitments. Can Redwood accommodate Net45 for the 2028 commitment and Net30 for any short prorate invoice?
- Tax: attaching W9 (separate attachment).

We're happy to accept a single consolidated invoice that includes the prorated 2027 true‑up and the 2028 prepay/commitment and will sign the PO once legal finishes the small delivery schedule redline.

Mira Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager | Staleworks
mira@staleworks.com
(206) 555-4432

(Attachment: W9_Staleworks.pdf (pdf))

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: ben_carter@redwood.inference, sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Commit true‑up: invoice routing, PO & tax evidence for 2028 capacity increase

Forwarding Mira's note — quick internal alignment: 

Ben / Evelyn, finance is asking whether we can accept split terms (Net45 for the 2028 committed pool, Net30 for the one‑time prorate true‑up). I approved Net45 for the annual commit given the size of the order, but we should:

1) Confirm invoice / remittance addresses and AP contacts.
2) Generate two line‑items on the single invoice (Prorate true‑up + 2028 commitment) with separate due dates matching the terms if they insist on split terms.
3) Flag any discounts/credits that were discussed on the last renewal call so the invoice reflects them.

Ben — can you prepare a draft invoice (PDF) we can send to Mira that includes PO placeholder and DocuSign link for signature? Evelyn, I've included you for tax / W9 confirmation.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

(On Tue, 22 Nov 2027, Mira Jensen wrote: "... we're happy to accept a single consolidated invoice ...")

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Mira Jensen <mira@staleworks.com>, accounts-payable@staleworks.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood invoice & PO confirmation — SW-PO-9843

Hi Mira / AP team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marissa / Sergio's notes we've prepared the invoice and included split due dates as requested: 

- Line 1: Prorated true‑up (remainder of 2027) — Amount: $18,750 — Due: 2027-12-29 (Net30)
- Line 2: 2028 capacity commitment (annual) — Amount: $225,000 — Due: 2028-02-12 (Net45)

Invoice includes PO placeholder SW-PO-9843. Once you attach the signed PO we'll update the invoice and issue a final PDF. Attached: Redwood_Invoice_2027-11-29.pdf (draft) and a DocuSign link for acceptance. Payment wiring instructions are in the invoice footer.

If Net45 for the 2028 line is a blocker, we can update but will need to reconfirm any early‑payment credits discussed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference

(Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_2027-11-29.pdf (pdf); DocuSign: https://docusign.com/records/ABC-12345)

From: Mira Jensen <mira@staleworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, accounts-payable@staleworks.com, Procurement Team <procurement@staleworks.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice & PO confirmation — SW-PO-9843

Ben / Team,

Appreciate the draft. We have attached the signed PO (SW-PO-9843) and confirm the W9 was uploaded earlier. Staleworks concurs with the split due dates as outlined. We'll process the prorate (Line 1) on Net30 and queue the 2028 commitment (Line 2) for payment on Net45.

Attaching: Signed PO (Staleworks_PO_2027-11-29.pdf). Please reissue the final invoice with the PO number embedded and send to payments@staleworks.com. Once finalized we'll route to our AR team for tracking.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff in January.

Mira Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager | Staleworks
(Attachment: Staleworks_PO_2027-11-29.pdf (pdf))
